title: Senior Performance Marketing (US Market)
subtitle: I.
body:
### **I. GENERAL INTRODUCTION **

PATI Group is entering a phase of hyper-growth with a goal of 20x our revenue within the next 12 months across** international markets (US/EU/AU).** We are not looking for typical media buyers. We are searching for **Marketing Experts** with **a logic-driven and data-driven mindset**, who can **master technology** and **manage large-scale budgets** to directly architect this growth.

At PATI, you will work in an AI-First environment (comprehensive AI integration), with full autonomy over your budget and direct accountability for business outcomes.

### **II. JOB DESCRIPTION **

You will hold a pivotal role in **operating the Marketing Performance** system:

- **Scale Up (Budget Operation): **Directly plan and optimize advertising budgets of $50,000+/month on Meta and TikTok platforms. You hold final accountability for performance metrics (ROAS) and Net Profit.

- **System Integrity (Tracking Management): **Ensure data infrastructure (Pixel, CAPI, GA4) operates with 99% accuracy. Ruthlessly resolve policy issues, handle account appeals, and maintain continuous system uptime.

- **Data Analysis: **Utilize logical thinking to analyze Cohort metrics, LTV (Customer Lifetime Value), and CAC. Identify “Winning Pockets” to make budget scaling decisions based on real-time data.

- **Mentorship: **Guide, technical review, and train junior personnel (Fresher/Junior) to multiply operational efficiency.

### **III. JOB REQUIREMENTS**

- **Experience: **Minimum **5 years of hands-on experience** in **Meta/Facebook Ads**. Experience handling **budgets >$50k/month** is mandatory (preference for POD, Dropship, or Global DTC).

- **Mathematical & Logical Thinking: **Extremely strong. You must work based on data, not intuition.

- **English Proficiency: **Fluent in **reading and comprehension** (IELTS 6.5+ or equivalent). Ability to scan technical documents, policy updates, and US market research fluently.

- **Technical Skills:**

eCommerce: Proven experience with eCommerce websites (Shopify) or Landing Page Builders (Ladipage or equivalent).

- AI Tools: Proficient in using AI tools, including but not limited to: ChatGPT, Gemini, and Claude.

### **IV. COMPENSATION & BENEFITS**

- **Unlimited Income: **Competitive base salary based on capability (starting from 25,000,000 VND) + Annual Performance Bonus (based on % of revenue growth you generate). You have the right to value yourself and negotiate with us.

- **Ownership Opportunity: **Eligibility for Equity (ownership stake) upon becoming a Key Member.

- **Premium Work Tools: **Provided with a MacBook, Premium AI accounts (Claude Pro, ChatGPT Plus, etc.), VinFast car & Gym membership (subject to company policy).

- **Comprehensive Benefits: **Social Insurance, Bao Viet Health Insurance (Green Card), bi-annual company trips, and full holiday/birthday bonuses.

### **V. ADDITIONAL INFORMATION**

- **Recruitment Process: **To ensure we find the right “Builders” for our x20 goal, our process includes:

**Round 1 - Application & Technical Challenge: **After submitting your CV (with Portfolio attached), you will receive a technical challenge.

- **Round 2 - In-depth Interview: **A discussion regarding technical expertise and cultural fit with PATI’s management team.

- **Round 3 - Founder’s Table: **Direct strategic discussion with the CEO.

- **Working Conditions:**

**Time: **

Monday - Friday: 8:30 AM - 5:30 PM, with a 1-hour lunch break.

- Saturday (Culture Day): 6:30 AM - 09:00 AM. We kick off Saturdays with team runs and weekly reflections - mind, body, and momentum aligned.

- **Location:** PATI Group Office – Ho Chi Minh City.

- **Note:** This is a full-time, onsite position to ensure the highest speed of coordination.
